attacks.name: Phasing Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
During this attack, the defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes, and cannot add additional dice to the defense roll as a result of |!critical| results.
|!wild| |*Sidestep|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of itself.

attacks.name: Get‘em Lockheed!
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Intangible Assault
steps: During this attack, the defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes and cannot add additional dice to the defense roll as a result of |!critical| results.
|!wild| |*Ghosted|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 2 of itself.

superPowers.name: Phase Rush
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Can‘t Touch This
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 2 is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or would make a dodge roll, this character may use this superpower. This character adds 2 dice to the defense or dodge roll. If this character or the allied character is Pushed or Thrown by the special rules of the attack, after the effect is resolved, you may Place the Pushed or Thrown character within |!range| 1 of itself.
